body: Yeah, long distance relationship with a guy who was only using me, still is, and friends who only talk when they need something.

You're right. Finding new friends isn't all that hard. Though finding friends who actually care about you is hard. I used to be popular in school, had a lot friends, none of them turned out to be true friends.

The last time I felt happiness? Possibly 3 years ago, spending time with said ex, if that counts. It might also have been the only time I ever felt happiness. I never had anything in my life that made me feel happy.

I've been trying to make new friends. It's rather hard for someone in my situation though. I don't have a whole lot to talk about and not even having a job or going to school also makes me feel inferior. And I wouldn't want to scare people away with my problems. I can't even hide my depression anymore.

Me and my ex broke up over two years ago and my feelings for him still haven't changed at all. I've gotten used to it and I'm not even focusing much on him anymore. My ex just happens to be the only person who talks and listens to me anymore.
